title: Super Cup ATTP – Autumn 2023: OPEN
excerpt: Results of the second stage of SUPER CUP ATTP – Autumn 2023
body_html:
The national tournament SUPER CUP ATTP – Autumn 2023 has ended, with more than 150 players taking part!

Master of Sport Igor Ni won the OPEN category and holds the Super Cup ATTP – Autumn 2023.

Second place on the podium went to Master of Sport and one of the top players of the SETKA-Pro project, Veniamin Dubrovin.

Alexandru Policiuc pleasantly surprised us with his original play, taking the third step of the podium and confirming his master’s level.

Looking back at the results, we want to stress that all the winners and medallists have come a long, hard way to the heights of sporting performance, and they now delight not only themselves but every table tennis fan with their excellent play and positive emotions.

We believe that if every coach and player raises their professionalism and responsibility for their work, we will bring Moldovan table tennis unprecedented glory. That belief rests on the fact that the country’s top coaches, working with young players in their schools, achieve much better results together with them.
